original_checks.name: Michael Bi
original_checks.quote: Michael Bi received his B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Purdue University in 2023, before beginning his Ph.D. at the University of Washington later that year. His current research focuses on optimizing human-robot interaction in shared autonomy systems.

original_checks.name: William Howe
original_checks.quote: William Howe received a B.S. and M.S. in Aerospace Engineering from California Polytechnic State University. He joined the Ph.D. program in 2023 and is currently researching mutli-agent robotics and information propagation in the presence of perception constraints.

original_checks.name: Aaron Weber
original_checks.quote: Aaron Weber received his B.S. in Electrical Engineering (minor in Applied Mathematics) from Gonzaga University in 2021, and started at UW as a Master's student that same year before transitioning to the PhD program in 2023. His research interests include multi-agent robotics, communications in robotic networks, odor localization, and bio-inspired robotics. He is working jointly with Prof. Sawyer Fuller.

original_checks.name: Henry Chang
original_checks.quote: Henry Chang Chang received his B.S. in Civil Engineering (minor in Mechanical Engineering) from National Cheng Kung University in 2017, and his M.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of California San Diego in 2020. Prior to his Ph.D. study, he worked for 1.5 years at Industrial Technology Research Institution (ITRI) as an autonomous driving engineer. He started his Ph.D. in 2022 with research interests in multi-agent robotics, data-driven control, and decision-making.

original_checks.name: Wade Marquette
original_checks.quote: Wade Marquette (PhD 25, most recent hire to Amazon)

Wade Marquette works at Amazon (2025) received a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (2019) and an M.S. in Mechanical Engineering (2021) from the University of Washington. His graduated with a PhD from the University of Washington's Mechanical Engineering department, where his research focused on robotics for confined space manufacturing in collaboration with the Boeing Advanced Research Center (BARC). During his PhD work, he developed and patented robots while conducting controls research to simplify robot teleoperation. Wade joined Amazon as a Postdoctoral Scientist in early 2025 and became an Amazon Innovation Engineer (2026) in the Worldwide Engineering and Innovation team, where he develops automated material handling equipment and robotic technologies for Amazon's delivery stations.

original_checks.name: Lance McCann
original_checks.quote: Lance McCann works at Amazon (2026). He has three degrees from the University of Washington, receiving his BSME in 2000, his Masters in Applied Physics in 2008, and PhD in 2024. As part of his Masters program, Lance developed technology for Magnetic Resonance Force Microscopy. Lance worked five years as an applications engineer for Pacific Machine Automation, where he developed automated equipment for a wide variety of industrial applications. Since 2006, he has worked for the Boeing Company developing automated technology for the fabrication and assembly of composite structures. In 2026 he moved to Amazon. He worked jointly with Prof. Joe Garbini.

original_checks.name: Leon Yan

His research interests include data-based dynamics modeling and precision control.

original_checks.name: Yoshua Gombo
original_checks.quote: Yoshua Gombo joined Konstruksi.AI in 2024. Yoshua started in 2018 as a Master’s student and transitioned to Ph.D. program in Autumn 2019. He recieved his PhD in 2023. His current research interest is in multi-robotic systems.

original_checks.name: Ben Tereshchuk
original_checks.quote: Ben Tereshchuk joined Boeing, Inc in 2020. He received his B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Washington in 2015 with a focus in mechatronics, and then got his Master's of Science in Mechanical Engineering in 2016. original_checks.name: Rose Hendrix
original_checks.quote: Rose Hendrix Currently working at the Allen Institute. original_checks.name: Parker Owan

His research interests include controls, mechatronics, and system identification.

original_checks.name: Rahul B Warrier
original_checks.quote: Rahul B Warrier joined Amazon Robotics in 2018. He received a Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, India. He obtained the Ph.D. degree at the University of Washington in Seattle, Washington in 2018. His current research interests include machine learning, user intent prediction and their applications in the control of systems. .

original_checks.name: Brandon Smith
original_checks.quote: Brandon Smith joined Tethers Unlimited. He received a Bachelors of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Washington in 2008. He then received a Masters of Science from the University of Washington in 2009. His focus was in systems dynamics and control systems, and his research was in mixing with microfluidics. After that, he worked on hard disk drives for Western Digital Corporation for three years in their servo pattern write group. There he made contributions in spindle control and advanced servo write techniques with two patents pending. He obtained the Ph.D. degree at the University of Washington in Seattle, Washington in 2017, working jointly with Prof. Mark Tuttle. His research interests are in identification and control of heat transfer in composite materials.

original_checks.name: Jonathan Realmuto

Jonathan's research is focused on the development of powered ankle prosthetics.

original_checks.name: Nathan Banka

Currently he is a Ph.D. Candidate and a Research Assistant at the REALab. Yury's research interests revolve around power system economics, operations, and planning. In his research Yury aims to optimize the use of available energy resources in order to improve overall power system performance, which is currently being challenged by constantly growing uncertainties. After graduation, Yury took upon an assitant professorship at New York University.
